ruleDefinitions.name: Virtualbox Driver Installation or Starting of VMs
ruleDefinitions.description: Adversaries can carry out malicious operations using a virtual instance to avoid detection. This rule is built to detect the registration of the Virtualbox driver or start of a Virtualbox VM.

sequences.query: ((process_command_line = RGX(".*VBoxRT\\\.dll\\,RTR3Init.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*VBoxC\\\.dll.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*VBoxDrv\\\.sys.*")) OR (process_command_line = RGX(".*startvm.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*controlvm.*")))
